source_text: In October 2023, WHO reaffirmed VMMC's cost-effectiveness—estimated at $2,000–$4,000 per infection averted—at current coverage levels below 60% in many priority countries, urging intensified efforts to achieve 90% coverage among males aged 15–29 to maximize population-level impact amid competing prevention priorities like pre-exposure prophylaxis. [57]
